name: aqi-air-quality
title: AQI Air Quality
description: An air quality information extension that allows you to see air quality in your status bar
author: riccardogiorato

commands.name: air-quality
commands.title: Air Quality
commands.description: Show air quality information in your status bar

preferences.name: locationQuery
preferences.title: Manual Location
preferences.description: Optional. Leave blank to use IP-based location. Sources: IQAir (if key) or Open-Meteo for AQI; KeyCDN for IP geolocation.

preferences.name: aqiScale
preferences.title: AQI Scale
preferences.description: Choose which AQI scale to display. If unavailable, the extension falls back to the other scale.

preferences.name: iqairApiKey
preferences.title: IQAIR API Key
preferences.description: Optional. Provides more precise AQI when available. Sources: IQAir (if key) or Open-Meteo for AQI; KeyCDN for IP geolocation.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
